text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia. The combination of severe anemia, thrombocytopenia, and leukocytosis (WBC 81,000) with peripheral blood smear showing immature cells (blasts) containing Auer rods (pink, needle-shaped inclusions) is pathognomonic for AML. I will now request a bone marrow biopsy and flow cytometry to confirm the diagnosis and determine the specific subtype.
